verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for an AI gateway platform, but the evidence pack shows no assistant, copilot, or official MCP server for managing Kong AI Gateway itself. The kongctl CLI uses declarative config and imperative commands, not natural language. The MCP Proxy, which turns user APIs into MCP tools, is a developer building block rather than natural-language control of the product. Proxying AI CLI traffic is an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
